settings.copy: Little Wings Foundation gives children in need a warm meal, a place to belong, and the chance to dream big — one community at a time.

trust_list.text: 91¢ of every dollar goes directly to children

stats.label: Volunteers giving their time and care

settings.title: Three ways we
settings.intro: Hunger, isolation, and limited opportunity hold children back before they even begin. We meet those needs head-on with programs built around the whole child.

features.title: Full Bellies
features.text: Weekend meal packs and after-school suppers that mean no child sits down to homework on an empty stomach. Nutrition isn't a perk — it's the foundation.

features.title: Safe Spaces
features.text: After-school and holiday clubs where kids find a warm room, caring adults, and a routine they can count on — a steady anchor in an unsteady world.

features.title: Big Dreams
features.text: Mentoring, tutoring, and kit grants that turn a child's ambition into a plan — school shoes, art supplies, sports kit, and the belief that the future is theirs.

features.title: Family Support
features.text: We don't help a child in isolation. Emergency groceries, clothing, and connection to local services help whole families stand back up together.

features.title: Holiday Magic
features.text: Summer day trips and festive gifts that give children the childhood moments too many miss out on — the first beach visit, the first wrapped present.

features.title: Community Roots
features.text: We partner with schools, churches, and local businesses so support is woven into the neighborhood — not parachuted in from far away.

settings.title: From your gift to
settings.note: Every donation is tracked from the moment it arrives to the moment it's spent, and we publish exactly how it was used. Your care goes where it's promised.

steps.title: Give
steps.text: A one-off gift or a monthly pledge — whatever fits your season of life. Every amount changes a day.

steps.title: We plan
steps.text: Your donation is pooled with others and allocated against our real, current needs — meals this week, kit for term, a club that's short on chairs.

steps.title: It reaches kids
steps.text: Funds flow to the programs and families that need them most, delivered by staff and volunteers who know each child by name.

steps.title: You see the impact
steps.text: We report back with stories, photos, and honest numbers — so you know the difference you made, not just that you made one.

settings.title: Be the reason a
settings.quote: A child who is fed, safe, and believed in will surprise the world. We just help them get to the starting line.

settings.title: What your kindness
settings.intro: Parents, teachers, and the children themselves on what Little Wings has meant.

reviews.quote: The weekend food packs meant my daughter stopped asking if we could afford dinner. That's a weight no child should carry, and you carried it for us.
reviews.author: M. Okafor

reviews.quote: I've seen a kid go from hiding in the back of the room to standing at the front to read their story aloud. That didn't happen by accident — it happened because someone believed in them every single week.
reviews.author: Mrs. D. Ellery

reviews.quote: We give monthly because we can see exactly where it goes. When your charity is that honest, you don't think twice about it.
reviews.author: H. & J. Whitfield

settings.title: Questions we
settings.intro: A few answers about how Little Wings works and where your gift goes.

items.question: What percentage of donations reaches children directly?
items.answer: 91 cents of every dollar goes straight to programs for children and families. The rest covers the essentials of running a charity responsibly — and we publish the breakdown every year.

items.question: Can I sponsor a specific child?
items.answer: Yes. Our sponsorship program pairs a monthly gift with one named child, so you follow their progress and milestones throughout the year. Most supporters tell us it's the most rewarding giving they've ever done.

items.question: How do you choose which children and families to support?
items.answer: We work through partner schools, shelters, and community centers that refer families in genuine need. A small, caring team assesses each case individually — no child is turned away if we can help.

items.question: Can I volunteer?
items.answer: Absolutely. We're always looking for meal-pack helpers, club assistants, and mentors. All volunteers go through a thorough child-safety vetting and training before meeting any child.

settings.title: Give, volunteer, or
settings.intro: Whether you want to make a gift, bring your company on board, or spend an afternoon volunteering, we'd love to hear from you.
